title: Update documentation for @object-ui/views package reclassification
body:
Package `@object-ui/plugin-object` has been reclassified from plugin to core package as `@object-ui/views`. This updates all documentation and examples to reflect the new package name and promotes the documentation to top-level navigation.

## Changes

- **Import statements**: Updated all code examples from `@object-ui/plugin-object` to `@object-ui/views`
- **Documentation location**: Moved views documentation from `/docs/plugins/views/*` to `/docs/views/*` (core package location)
- **Documentation links**: Updated all internal references to use new `/docs/views/*` path structure
- **Navigation metadata**: Changed section title from "Plugin Object" to "Views" and promoted to top-level navigation alongside "guide" and "components"

## Example

Before:
```tsx
import { ObjectForm } from '@object-ui/plugin-object';
```

After:
```tsx
import { ObjectForm } from '@object-ui/views';
```

## Documentation Structure

**Before:**
- `/docs/plugins/views/` (nested under plugins)

**After:**
- `/docs/views/` (promoted to top-level, reflecting core package status)

## Files Modified

**Navigation:**
- `content/docs/meta.json` - Added "views" to top-level navigation
- `content/docs/plugins/meta.json` - Removed "views" from plugins section
- `content/docs/plugins/index.md` - Updated 3 references to point to new location

**Documentation Location:**
- Moved entire `content/docs/plugins/views/` directory to `content/docs/views/`

**Link Updates:**
- `content/docs/views/meta.json` - Navigation title
- `content/docs/views/index.mdx` - 3 internal links updated
- `content/docs/views/object-view.mdx` - Import + 4 links updated
- `content/docs/views/object-grid.mdx` - Import + 4 links updated  
- `content/docs/views/object-form.mdx` - Import + 3 links updated
- `content/docs/views/object-field.mdx` - 3 links updated

CHANGELOG files intentionally left unchanged as historical records.
